subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable message presentation/message-tool multi-select contract now, and what selected-values callback shape should it expose across Slack, Discord, Telegram, and fallback channels?
rationale: The remaining work changes public message-tool and Plugin SDK semantics across multiple channel render/callback paths, so automation should not choose the product API shape alone.

options.title: Add shared portable multi-select
options.body: Add an additive shared presentation block/tool schema with min/max selection, typed selected-values aggregation, docs, and channel-specific rendering/fallback coverage.

options.title: Keep it channel specific
options.body: Defer the portable contract and let Slack modals, Discord components, Telegram flows, or plugins solve structured input independently.

options.title: Fold into dialog/forms design
options.body: Use a broader dialog or form API for deterministic data collection and leave message presentation unchanged until that API is agreed.

recommendation.title: Add shared portable multi-select
recommendation.body: Add an additive shared presentation block/tool schema with min/max selection, typed selected-values aggregation, docs, and channel-specific rendering/fallback coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared presentation contract and docs history most directly route through steipete's recent work.
